blocks.text: An effect listens for actions and can return new actions after outside work. Reducers can stay focused on state changes.

Use an Angular project with the matching major version of @ngrx/store. Effects and SignalStore examples also need @ngrx/effects or @ngrx/signals. Save linked snippets in the files named by their imports.

blocks.title: Keep outside work in an effect

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `createEffect` listens to actions for outside work and can produce follow-up actions.

blocks.text: A loadBooks action is followed by booksLoaded with local sample data.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not listen for the same action you return without a stopping rule. That can create an endless effect loop.
